messages.author: d42e88b7645d03c8
messages.subject: Re: Date (char) convert to Date (numeric)
parts:
Hi Kevin,

Please refer to the following:

1. The return value of a character data is a "NA" except this data can be enforced for a number. Eg . as.numeric("ABC" ) --> NA, as.numeric("123") --> 123.

2. First, we use as.Date function, followed by the as.numeric function.

messages.author: d42e88b7645d03c8
messages.subject: Re: Date (char) convert to Date (numeric)
parts:
Hi Kevin,

EXCEL 與 R 的基準日計算基礎不同, 因此結果不一樣.

# title: Date-time Conversion
# date: 2017.4.24

# Windows Excel 設定 1900-01-01 為日期1, eg. =TEXT("2017/4/12  10:09:41 PM", "[ss]") --> 3701196581
# Windows R 設定 1970-01-01 為日期1.

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C") # 地區設定
as.numeric(as.Date("4/12/2017 10:09:41 PM", "%m/%d/%Y")) # 回傳日期之日數值(整數) 17268
as.numeric(strptime("04/12/2017 10:09:41 PM", format="%m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p")) #  回傳含日期與時分秒之秒數值1492006181
# end
